app.name: SuperTux Wii
app.long_description:
Wii port of the classic platformer starring Tux the Penguin - Based on Milestone 1 of the game, originally released in 2003 - Originally ported by scanff & Arikado - Updated by Deltaresero with various improvements and fixes - Includes 9 unique enemies and 26 challenging levels - Supports Wii Remote, Nunchuk, C/GC Controller, & keyboard
For more info, visit: github.com/DeltaResero/SuperTux-Wii
